verified_facts.text: The hotel opened in 1890 at the base of Higashiyama.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Westin Miyako Kyoto opened in 1890 at the base of Higashiyama in the ancient capital city of Kyoto, Japan.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in eastern Kyoto at the edge of the Higashiyama mountain range, with numerous UNESCO heritage sites within walking distance.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Westin Miyako Kyoto is located in the traditional district of eastern Kyoto, at the edge of the Higashiyama mountain range with numerous UNESCO heritage sites in walking distance.

verified_facts.text: Nearby temples and shrines include the Heian Shrine, Nanzenji, Eikando and Ginkakuji.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nearby explore museums, music halls, zoos, historical temples and shrines, including the Nanzenji, Heian Shrine, Eikando and Ginkakuji.

verified_facts.text: The Kasui-en annex was designed by architect Togo Murano in 1959 and is hailed as a masterpiece of modernist Japanese architecture.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel’s outstanding annex, hailed as a masterpiece of modernist Japanese architecture, was designed by celebrated architect Togo Murano in 1959.

verified_facts.text: Kyoto Keage Onsen hot spring water flows from the ground beneath the hotel, feeding indoor and semi-open-air onsen baths for men and women.
verified_facts.excerpt: “Kyoto Keage Onsen” flows from the ground beneath the hotel; these waters enhance recovery from fatigue and coldness. Our indoor and semi-open-air Onsen baths are accessible to both men and women.

verified_facts.text: Spa KACHO's semi-open-air bath looks out on the hotel's garden leading to Mount Kacho.
verified_facts.excerpt: Semi open-air bath that blends in breath-taking views of the hotel’s garden leading to Mt. Kacho

verified_facts.text: Spa KACHO's design was inspired by the brick, moss-covered Suirokaku aqueduct at Nanzenji Temple.
verified_facts.excerpt: the design of Spa KACHO was inspired by the brick and moss-covered Suirokaku aqueduct, built on the grounds of nearby Nanzenji Temple in 1889.

verified_facts.text: Le Jardin Sothys offers programs including hot spring baths, traditional Japanese massage, acupressure, moxibustion and meditation.
verified_facts.excerpt: help you select a healing program that includes hot spring baths, traditional Japanese massages, acupressure, moxibustion, and meditation.

verified_facts.text: A trail near the hotel climbs toward the Ohyakuinari Shrine through a forest that is home to over 50 species of wild birds.
verified_facts.excerpt: wander the trail near our Kyoto spa hotel, which ascends toward the Ohyakuinari Shrine and Jizo relics, and enjoy the peace and tranquility of a serene green forest that is a natural habitat for over 50 species of wild birds.

verified_facts.text: The hotel arranges experiences such as hotel tours, sake tasting and kimono fittings.
verified_facts.excerpt: including hotel tours, sake tasting, kimono fittings, and more.

verified_facts.text: Rooms use soft curving forms and wood floors and walls, with carpets inspired by Kyoto's kawadoko river-floor summer dining.
verified_facts.excerpt: Soft curvilinear forms and the use of wood on floors and walls, along with carpets inspired by Kyoto's summer dining traditions of kawadoko or “river floor”, create serene spaces

verified_facts.text: The Westin Club lounge serves coffee, tea and other drinks, with a cocktail hour at the end of the day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy coffee, tea, and other beverages or a cocktail hour at the end of the day.

verified_facts.text: RAQOU, the all-day restaurant, overlooks Higashiyama and the city of Kyoto.
verified_facts.excerpt: RAQOU, the hotel’s smart-casual all day dining restaurant that overlooks the picturesque natural surroundings of Higashiyama and the city of Kyoto.
No, pets are not allowed at The Westin Miyako Kyoto.

verified_facts.text: The closest airport is Osaka International Airport (Itami), about 60 kilometers away.
verified_facts.excerpt: The closest airport near The Westin Miyako Kyoto is Osaka International Airport - Itami (ITM). ITM is located approximately 60.0 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a satellite concierge baggage counter at Kyoto Station for guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Satellite ConciergeKyoto Station baggage storage service counter for hotel guests.
